items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Names are clear (numClippedShapes, csShapeID, loopCounts), but the ShapeIndex.Decode/Encode blocks of 80–150 lines have no inline comments on the wire layout. Doc comments are minimal ("Encode encodes the LaxPolygon.").

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: ShapeIndex.Decode runs about 150 lines (over the 100-line cap) with nesting 4+ deep. Encode/Decode were put in shapeindex.go, not a dedicated shapeindex_encode.go. The per-tag switch is duplicated in Encode and Decode, and each one wraps sub-Encode/Decode calls that create new encoders around e.w/d.r.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Loop/LaxLoop are not supported ("cannot be encoded"). The 100M limits still allow huge allocations: make([]CellID, numCells) runs before any data is read. maxEdgesPerCell is not validated. Hidden tests Truncated/ByteCorruption fail.

items.name: Existing encodings and Shape interface unchanged
items.name_zh: 既有编码格式与 Shape 接口不变
items.evidence: Only additive changes: new Encode/Decode methods and a readInt32 helper. Existing Polygon/Polyline wire formats and typeTag numbering are untouched, and the Shape interface is unchanged.
